thread:
june: Quick idea  snack roulette on Fridays? we each toss in $1 and someone buys treats. also the coffee thermometer is blinking 0C again, anyone know where the spare is?
ryan: snack roulette sounds fun. last time i paid and got only kale chips  would like a veto power for kale.
priya: :raised_hands: for roulette. veto list seems reasonable: kale, durian, mystery tuna.
hattie: I'll volunteer to manage the first round if people trust me not to buy only cookies. promise: at least one savory option.
leo: Re: thermometer, i think it fell behind the machine. i pulled it out last week and left it on the shelf labelled "coffee bits". no promises on battery life.
kitchen-bot: Inventory alert: cocoa packets 3, sugar 2/5 jars, coffee thermometer status: missing. Suggested action: replace thermometer and restock sugar. react :bell:
june: Thanks @kitchen-bot. @hattie you are now Snack Captain Week 1. Can we also add a tiny sign: "If you take the last of something, please restock or add $1 to the jar"?
hattie: Adding sign template now. Also starting a small shared note with allergies/preferences. will DM folks to add.
ryan: Veto power ballot: chocolate > kale. democratically decided.
priya: Also small etiquette note: if you reheat strong-smelling food, please use the sealed lunch box and open windows. plants deserve better.
leo: I grabbed a AAA battery and put it near the coffee shelf. if someone can test it in the thermometer that would be great.
kitchen-bot: Action logged: battery replacement suggested. Coffee temp suggested target: 68-70C for espresso boiler, 60-65C for brewed. react :white_check_mark:
june: Thanks all. Hattie, I'll Venmo you $1 for the jar and add my snack preferences to the list. Also adding a tiny "no reheated fish" sticker to the microwave.
hattie: Received $1, thanks! I'll pick treats at 3:15 and leave a label with contents and allergens.
priya: Yay snacks. Also can we please stop leaving used stirrers in the sink? tiny request.
leo: I'll test the thermometer now and leave it on top of the grinder if it works.
kitchen-bot: Update: thermometer tested by leo  battery replaced, working. Inventory updated: sugar jars 2/5. react :white_check_mark:
june: Snack roulette activated. May the odds be delicious. :tada:
